llm.guidance: This skill is instruction-only and requests no credentials, so it's low-risk from a permissions perspective. Before installing, consider: (1) provenance — there is no source/homepage and skill.json/registry versions differ (registry: 1.0.48 vs skill.json: 1.0.0); ask the publisher for source code or a homepage if you want higher assurance. (2) Data safety — the skill expects CSV test_data.csv; avoid uploading PII or production data until you verify where outputs are stored/processed. (3) Testing — run with synthetic data first to confirm behavior. (4) Reporting destination — SKILL.md doesn't state if results are sent externally; verify that reports are generated locally or to approved endpoints. If you need higher assurance, request the implementation or an install spec from the author before use.
